review: 702.15c-1: the lifelink creature (Child of Night) has lifelink printed, so the graveyard card has lifelink too and the pair did not depend on last known information; replaced it with Grizzly Bears whose lifelink comes from the Lifelink Aura, which is gone by the time the trigger deals damage, and made the variant remove the Aura.

scenarios.title: Damage dealt by a lifelink source makes its controller gain that much life
decisions: A attacks player B with Child of Night.
B declares no blockers and passes priority without casting a spell.

variants.label: unblocked
variants.expected: Child of Night deals 2 damage to B, whose life is 18. A gains 2 life and is at 22.

variants.label: blocked
variants.delta: B blocks Child of Night with Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Child of Night and Grizzly Bears deal 2 damage to each other and both are destroyed. A gains 2 life and is at 22. B stays at 20.

variants.label: damage_prevented
variants.delta: B casts Holy Day (tapping Plains) in the declare blockers step, without blocking.
variants.expected: Holy Day resolves and all combat damage is prevented. B stays at 20 and A stays at 20.

scenarios.title: A creature that dies with lifelink granted by an Aura still gains life when it deals damage from the graveyard, by last known information

setup.notes: Lifelink (the Aura) is controlled by A and attached to A's Grizzly Bears.

decisions: A casts Shock targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Mountain.
Both players pass; Shock resolves, and in the state-based check Grizzly Bears dies and Lifelink (the Aura) goes to A's graveyard.
Stalking Vengeance triggers; A targets player B with it. Both players pass; it resolves.

variants.label: lifelink_aura_attached
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears and Lifelink go to A's graveyard. The trigger makes Grizzly Bears deal 2 damage to B (life 18), and A gains 2 life (life 22).

variants.label: no_aura
variants.delta: Lifelink (the Aura) is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears goes to A's graveyard. The trigger makes Grizzly Bears deal 2 damage to B (life 18), and A gains no life (life 20).

scenarios.forge_notes: Stalking Vengeance is cast for seven mana in real play; here it is already on the battlefield. Forge's trigger uses TriggeredCardLKICopy as the damage source, so the last known Grizzly Bears, with the Aura's lifelink, deals the damage.

scenarios.title: A spell on the stack with lifelink causes life gain when it deals damage
decisions: A casts Shock targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Mountain.

variants.label: own_grand_master
variants.expected: Shock, a spell with lifelink from the stack, deals 2 damage to Grizzly Bears, which is destroyed. A gains 2 life and is at 22.

variants.label: opposing_grand_master
variants.delta: Soulfire Grand Master is on B's battlefield instead of A's.
variants.expected: Shock deals 2 damage to Grizzly Bears, which is destroyed. A gains no life and stays at 20.

scenarios.forge_notes: Lifelink is granted to the spell by Soulfire Grand Master's static ability while the spell is on the stack.

scenarios.title: Simultaneous lifelink damage from several sources causes separate life gain events
decisions: A attacks player B with both Child of Night, and not with Ajani's Pridemate or Grizzly Bears.
Combat damage is dealt; each Pridemate trigger is put on the stack and resolves.

variants.label: two_lifelink_attackers
variants.expected: A gains 2 life twice (life 24) and B is at 16. Ajani's Pridemate triggers twice and gets two +1/+1 counters (4/4).

variants.label: one_lifelink_attacker
variants.delta: A attacks with one Child of Night and Grizzly Bears instead of both Child of Night.
variants.expected: B is at 16. A gains 2 life once (life 22). Ajani's Pridemate triggers once and gets one +1/+1 counter (3/3).

scenarios.forge_notes: Each lifelink source gains life separately in Forge; the Pridemate trigger count is the observable.
